snippet.title: Marbies Party - Steam Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Marbies Party is a chaotic local party game playable up to 4, in which you play as silly little rounded characters running around mazes. Get in your opponents' way as you play a variety of game modes all the way to victory! ◕‿◕ (ǝɹoɯ sᴉ ǝɹǝɥʇ ʇnq)

Wishlist Marbies Party: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3648320/Marbies_Party/?utm_medium=web&utm_source=yt_trailer

Music: Corentin Brasart https://youtube.com/channel/UCfduwSF5Zw6ArNyh-HZ-j3w?si=uXsGQZ5pEQ7e9_IV
